title: Keypad treatment on wear (huawei watch 2) is squashed, causing entry errors
symptom: The rows of keypad treatment's number entry and action buttons on the Huawei Watch 2's small, round face are too squashed together, causing entry errors such as accidentally approving or cancelling an entry when trying to select a number on the last row.
evidence_quote: The rows of keypad treatment's number entry and action buttons on this watch's small, round face are too squashed together (as if the line height was < 1.0), resulting in entry errors.
